clips.title: The story
paras: Candles of Beckoning is a brief task centered around salvaging specialized ritual tapers discovered in Tirisfal Glades. These eerie tallow candles are steeped in dark practices and recovered from a crate on Gunther's Retreat, Gunther Arcanus's island in Brightwater Lake.

The crate on Gunther's Retreat supplies the Candle of Beckoning used in his test of allegiance. Gunther asks an adventurer to take a candle to the old, bloody altar just off the island's southern coast, light it, and confront the Scourge agent Lillith Nefara.

The crate holding these candles sits on Gunther's Retreat, the island in Brightwater Lake where the lich Gunther Arcanus dwells. A single candle is all that is needed for the test Gunther sets in Proving Allegiance: lit upon the old, bloody altar off the island's southern coast, it awakens the Scourge agent Lillith Nefara.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
